source: Browse leagues available in Sportarr. Requesting a league adds it to Sportarr using its configured quality profile and folder settings. If an administrator links IPTV Tunerr in Settings > Services, Sportarr can also use Tunerr’s live sports feeds for its DVR.

source: Browse leagues available in Sportarr. Requesting a league adds it to Sportarr using its configured quality profile and folder settings. If an administrator links IPTV Tunerr in Settings > Services, Sportarr can also use Tunerr’s live sports feeds for its DVR.

source: Browse leagues available in Sportarr. Requesting a league adds it to Sportarr using its configured quality profile and folder settings. If an administrator links IPTV Tunerr in Settings > Services, Sportarr can also use Tunerr’s live sports feeds for its DVR.

source: Browse leagues available in Sportarr. Requesting a league adds it to Sportarr using its configured quality profile and folder settings. If an administrator links IPTV Tunerr in Settings > Services, Sportarr can also use Tunerr’s live sports feeds for its DVR.
